source_authorities.title: Hydrothermal Treatment of Waste Plastics: An Environmental Impact Study
source_authorities.role: facility-gate mixed-polyolefin preparation and hydrothermal-treatment process boundary
source_locations: ecoinvent 3.12 linked documentation and native activities
source_authorities.authors: Matthew C. Ozoemena; Stuart R. Coles

method_authority.technology_boundary: Only the material composition catalogue's eligible PE/PP constituents enter mixed-polyolefin preparation and hydrothermal treatment. Naphtha plus distillate gas oil supplies the native naphtha cracker as a prospective proxy. Recovered ethylene/propylene and virgin makeup supply one destination polymerization operation.
method_authority.allocation_boundary: Normalize preparation to processed plastic plus combustible plastic reject and hydrothermal inventories to processed plastic input. The MFA recipe removes allocation to derive yields and gross monomer requirements; LCI retains actual dated allocated monomer exchange coefficients.
method_authority.geography_year_boundary: Preparation, hydrothermal treatment, embedded reject treatment, cracking and polymerization use ecoinvent 3.12 through 2025, interpolate to the matching premise 2030 anchor during 2026-2029, and use matching-member premise anchors from 2030. The preparation and hydrothermal operations use the native GB datasets as common technology proxies; locations in the 12 world regions and selected inventory location remain distinct.
method_authority.limitation: Fixed constituent shares apply across regions and years. Hydrothermal naphtha/DGO supplies the naphtha steam-cracker proxy. The tracked-plastic denominator includes inseparable reject dust. Heavy oil, wax and nonpolymer cracker products leave the plastics boundary. Effective monomer-carbon retention is equal across the recovered monomers.

preparation.functional_unit: 1 kg tracked plastic entering chemical-recycling preparation

selector.name: treatment of waste mixed polyolefins, unprocessed, sorting

preparation.retained_boundary: Remove only self-production and the internal processed-feed output; retain utilities, infrastructure, water, combustible reject routing and treatment, inert output, and zero-burden metal outputs once. Normalize the project production to the tracked-plastic denominator.

conversion.activity_name: treatment of waste mixed polyolefins, processed, hydrothermal treatment

denominator_selector.name: market for waste mixed polyolefins, processed

conversion.retained_boundary: Retain the common operation vector after removing the sibling productions and processed-feed denominator.
